Agentic AI is a new kind of tool, and following [Ethan Mollick's](https://www.oneusefulthing.org/) advice, I've tried to use it wherever I can and learn where it helps and where it falls short. At this point, I use AI to support much of my work, but I still control the "big decisions" on implementation, design, interpretation, etc.

This section of my website provides additional detail, including a visual map of where AI fits across my work and a generic "disclosure" statement.
